scope: One separate presentation recheck, excluded from original 120-interview and 360-response scores
review: Per-key Map histories append increasing timestamps. Upper-bound binary search on [left,right) finds the first timestamp greater than the query, so left-1 supplies the latest qualifying stored value and left=0 returns null. Map separates inherited-name keys and stored zero remains valid. Amortized O(1) set, O(log(history length)) get, O(sets+gets) storage including results. Fresh marker, frozen grades, accepted source paints and global reading keys all passed.
lesson: A toolbar obscured the original no-match rule; initial refusal is preserved. Before the recheck explicit shortcut, Computer Use verified all task text visible in a narrower synthetic prompt. The app already suppresses its own answer overlay during capture. Toolbar ownership was not established; no app overlay defect is claimed.
